vortimer-pattern-razorback.name: Vortimer Pattern Razorback
vortimer-pattern-razorback.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport TERMINATOR or JUMP PACK models.

vortimer-pattern-land-raider-redeemer.name: Vortimer Pattern Land Raider Redeemer
vortimer-pattern-land-raider-redeemer.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR and JUMP PACK model takes up the space of 2 other models.

thunderhawk-assault-gunship.name: Thunderhawk Assault Gunship
thunderhawk-assault-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 30 friendly GREY KNIGHTS and/or INQUISITION INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR model takes up the space of 2 other models.

land-raider.name: Land Raider
land-raider.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models.

land-raider-crusader.name: Land Raider Crusader
land-raider-crusader.transport: This unit can transport up to 16 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models.

land-raider-redeemer.name: Land Raider Redeemer
land-raider-redeemer.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. Each TERMINATOR model takes the space of 2 other INFANTRY models.

razorback.name: Razorback
razorback.transport: This unit can transport up to 6 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport TERMINATOR units.

rhino.name: Rhino
rhino.transport: This unit can transport up to 10 friendly GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport TERMINATOR units.

stormraven-gunship.name: Stormraven Gunship
stormraven-gunship.transport: This unit can transport up to 12 friendly <Chapter> Infantry models and 1 friendly <Chapter> Dreadnought. Each Jump Pack, Wulfen, or Terminator model takes the space of 2 other Infantry models, and each Centurion model takes the space of 3 other Infantry models. It cannot transport Primaris units.

chapter-master.name: Chapter Master
chapter-master.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made by friendly GREY KNIGHTS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

bane-of-evil.name: Bane of Evil
bane-of-evil.text: Whilst they are within 6" of this unit, you can re-roll wound rolls for attacks made by friendly GREY KNIGHTS units that target DAEMON units.

master-psyker.name: Master Psyker
master-psyker.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw either one Adeptus Astartes Command Asset of your choice that is a psychic power, or the Deny the Witch or Adamantium Will card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

master-swordsman.name: Master Swordsman
master-swordsman.text: You can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by this unit with melee weapons.

the-strands-of-fate.name: The Strands of Fate
the-strands-of-fate.text: Once per turn, after you have made a saving throw for this unit, you can re-roll that saving throw.

litanies-of-hate.name: Litanies of Hate
litanies-of-hate.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by friendly GREY KNIGHTS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

spiritual-leader.name: Spiritual Leader
spiritual-leader.text: Friendly GREY KNIGHTS units can use this unit’s Leadership characteristic instead of their own whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

narthecium.name: Narthecium
narthecium.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to heal one friendly GREY KNIGHTS LIGHT unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that LIGHT unit. Only one attempt to heal each unit can be made each turn.

personal-teleporters.name: Personal Teleporters
personal-teleporters.text: This unit can move across models and terrain as if they were not there. When this unit makes a Move action, it can make a teleport shunt instead of moving. If it does, it is removed from the battlefield and placed into Tactical Reserves. When this unit arrives as reinforcements, set it up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from any enemy units. A unit cannot make a teleport shunt if it was set up on the battlefield this turn, if there are any enemy units in base contact with it, or if there are any blast markers next to it.

blessings-of-the-omnissiah.name: Blessings of the Omnissiah
blessings-of-the-omnissiah.text: At the end of the Action phase, this unit can attempt to repair one friendly GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit in base contact with it. If it does, roll one D6; on a 4+ remove one damage marker from that VEHICLE unit. Only one attempt to repair each unit can be made each turn.

rites-of-battle.name: Rites of Battle
rites-of-battle.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly GREY KNIGHTS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

psychic-locus.name: Psychic Locus
psychic-locus.text: When a friendly GREY KNIGHTS unit is selected to manifest a psychic power whilst it is within 6" of any friendly units with this ability, after it is resolved roll one D12; on a 7+ return that Command Asset to your hand instead of discarding it. That Command Asset cannot be played again this turn.

heroic-sacrifice.name: Heroic Sacrifice
heroic-sacrifice.text: If this unit is destroyed whilst it is in base contact with any enemy units, place one blast marker next to one enemy unit in base contact with this unit before removing it from the battlefield.

sacred-banner.name: Sacred Banner
sacred-banner.text: Morale tests taken for friendly GREY KNIGHTS units are automatically passed whilst they are within 6" of this unit.
